title: matthiola livida
intro: Matthiola livida, commonly known as the Dune Stock or Living Stone, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues such as anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Matthiola livida include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
